## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Why does the current behavior get in your way?

> Example: "I run a 3-person company and want to share a Notion workspace across all three of our AI agents, but each agent today needs its own OAuth grant — I can't easily share approval authority."

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. The more concrete, the better.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you look at? Why is your proposal better?

- **Alternative A** — `<description>`. Pro: `<...>`. Con: `<...>`.
- **Alternative B** — `<description>`. Pro: `<...>`. Con: `<...>`.
- **Status quo** — keep things as they are.

## Scope

Which milestone does this fit into?

- [ ] **MVP / v0.x** — small change, no breaking API impact (e.g. new tool, new audit field, new env var)
- [ ] **v3.x (Cloud)** — needs Cloud v3 control plane + per-tenant DB
- [ ] **v4 (sandbox)** — needs V8 isolate runtime; significant refactor
- [ ] **Backlog** — interesting but no clear demand yet

## Willingness to contribute

- [ ] I will submit a PR with this change (and have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] I will help test this once implemented
- [ ] I will only file and discuss — no implementation
